sentences.en: They lived on corn, potatoes, and the meat of animals.
sentences.zh: 他们靠玉米、土豆和动物肉为生。

sentences.en: After a while, corn flakes in milk will become soggy.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，牛奶里的玉米片会变软。

sentences.en: There will be a giant crop of corn this year.
sentences.zh: 今年将会有大量的玉米收成。
